detailed_description: The Stacked Area Chart Generator shows how several series contribute to a changing total across time or ordered categories. It is useful when you want to keep the overall trend visible while also showing how each part of the total shifts over the same timeline. You can enter grouped data, adjust stack order, colors, labels, and legend settings, then export the final chart as PNG or SVG after checking the live preview in the browser.
usage_steps: Enter the ordered labels and values for each series you want to stack.
Set the chart title and confirm the series order matches the story you want to tell.
Adjust colors, legend visibility, and labels so each layer stays distinct.
Review the preview and refine the data if small sections are hard to read.
Export the completed stacked area chart as PNG or SVG for decks, dashboards, or reports.
usage_examples: Show how traffic sources contribute to total visits over time.
Visualize the changing mix of subscription plans across several quarters.
Track department headcount composition by month during a reorganization.
